sam (devex): opened a tiny PR with migration tips for the function/tool calling shape (tool -> tool_call) plus compact parse examples: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/529

ivy (docs): skimmed. please include a one-line grep/sed example and a short JS snippet that explicitly shows JSON.parse in try/catch. do not imply SDK auto-parses.

rahul (eng): agree. also add a safe perl -pi.bak example for people who want backups: perl -pi.bak -e 's/"tool"/"tool_call"/g' $(git grep -l '"tool"')

pat (ml): add a unit-test suggestion that feeds both a structured response and plain-text fallback. mention validating `arguments` with jsonschema.

sam (devex): adding all three. will mark the normalization heuristics as "advanced" and warn about lossy fixes.

pr-bot: label added: area:structured-output, needs-review  preview: https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/529

ivy (docs): nit: keep the schema snippet minimal so people can copy/paste. also add a one-line changelog note.

rahul (eng): tiny nit: in JS example show argsStr = resp.tool_call?.arguments ?? resp.tool?.args so older payloads still work.

sam (devex): updated, CI passing. merging after preview. thanks!
